title: Fixed Twin Gauge Manifold and Whole Hose Set
description: One newly authored complete twin-gauge manifold-style tool set in a fixed flat resting presentation. A whole short horizontal valve-body exterior carries two separate upper round gauge cases with actual recessed blank opaque faces, two end knobs, three lower whole hose sockets and one continuous open hanging hook. Three entire flexible-hose-shaped solids remain connected to the three lower sockets and terminate in complete blunt coupling exteriors. All belong to one complete set, not three separately counted hoses or two independently counted gauges. Unlike the old cuff/bulb instrument there is no cuff or squeeze bulb and the two gauges are directly rooted in a common two-knob manifold bar; unlike a receiver compressor there is no tank, trolley, belt or drive. All visible vertices newly authored, no old gauge or hose extracted. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, complete horizontally centred ground datum on the backs and hose undersides, one model zero scenes. Empty static artistic maintenance-tool exterior only: no readable scale, measurement, pressure, refrigerant, flow path, valve action, connection compatibility, service procedure, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
